A wizard’s apothecary. 3,240 magical jars scattered across its halls. Customers are already arriving, and somehow it is your job to put everything back in order.

Wizard Jars: Tidy Up Together is a cozy co-op sorting game about restoring a massive magical apothecary, helping customers, and bringing order back to the chaos — alone or with friends.

Put 3,240 Jars Back Where They Belong

Pick up thousands of jars scattered across the halls and return them to their proper shelves.

Watch empty shelves slowly fill up as the mess disappears and the apothecary begins to feel organized again.

Help Your Customers

Customers arrive with unusual problems and magical requests.

Find out what they need, search the shelves for the right ingredients, and complete their requests.

The better you know your shelves, the faster you can find exactly what you need.

Work Faster

Organize shelves and complete customer requests to unlock new upgrades.

Use the upgrade system to make collecting, carrying, and organizing faster and more efficient as you progress.

Work Together

Play alone at your own pace or invite your friends online.

Split up the halls, search for ingredients together, help customers, and coordinate using in-game voice chat.

Everything can start organized.

How long it stays that way is up to you.

Features

  • Collect and organize 3,240 magical jars

  • Restore a huge magical apothecary filled with shelves

  • Complete customer requests and find the right ingredients

  • Unlock upgrades that make your work faster

  • Solo play and online co-op

  • In-game voice chat

  • Relaxing, low-pressure progression

  • A satisfying transformation from chaos to order

Collect the jars. Fill the shelves. Help your customers. Bring the apothecary back to life.

Wizard of Maths is a revolutionary roguelike arithmetic adventure designed to change the way you think about numbers. Whether you’re a child or student just getting started, or an adult or professional looking to sharpen your skills, this game helps you conquer maths anxiety and build your numerical confidence using gameplay that’s both challenging and deeply rewarding.

Powered by the latest educational research and expert insights into mental arithmetic, Wizard of Maths delivers streamlined, highly effective gameplay. Each session is crafted to improve your numerical fluency and calculation speed, unlocking your inner “human calculator” as you progress.

Crafted by a seasoned developer at the forefront of educational games for engineers, scientists, and educators, Wizard of Maths sets a new standard for mental calculation and numerical mastery.

Don’t let the enchanting graphics fool you: beneath the adorable exterior lies a rigorous, unforgiving test of your mental arithmetic abilities. Perfect for croupier, finance, or banking candidates preparing for maths-intensive interviews, ambitious students looking to hone their skills, or anyone determined to overcome their fear of numbers. Wizard of Maths offers all the tools you need to manipulate numbers fluently in a fun-filled roguelike adventure. Additionally, a built-in game editor empowers you to tailor your learning journey, focusing on specific maths tricks and techniques that matter most to you.

  • Dynamic, progressive challenges that test and elevate your mental arithmetic abilities

  • An immersive, welcoming yet demanding JRPG-inspired universe designed to motivate and engage

  • Gameplay that’s designed to be understood and enjoyed by all ages

  • Lessons that prepare you for competitive academic and professional environments

  • Confidence-building exercises that help the maths-anxious to unlock fresh mathematical abilities.

Wizard of Maths offers an unparalleled collection of around 72 practical arithmetic tricks that have been carefully selected from best-selling maths shortcut books and modern mental maths literature. Every technique in Wizard of Maths is tailored for real-life application and rapid mastery, giving you the highest concentration of effective methods available on any platform.

Wizard of Maths is fully localised in nine languages: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Hindi—allowing players across the globe to join the adventure and grow their skills in their native tongue.

Are you ready to become a true Wizard of Maths? Embark on your journey today and watch your mastery of numbers reach legendary heights!

Wizard's Path: Palette of Spells is a survivors-like action roguelite where the spells you choose determine what kind of mage you become.

Fight through growing swarms of enemies, collect XP, level up, and build your own combination of spells. As your build takes shape, you'll discover a mage identity based on the magic types you've chosen.

You can focus entirely on one type of magic or experiment with combinations that take your build in a completely different direction.

14+ MAGIC TYPES. 470+ MAGES.

Fire. Frost. Storm. Arcane. Blood. Shadow. Holy. Nature. Death. Summoner. Growth. Chaos. Greed. Challenger.

Each magic type offers different spells and ways to build your character.

Specializing in a single type lets you reach higher spell levels, while combining two or three types gives you access to more abilities and different interactions.

There are over 470 mage identities to discover, each with its own name, passives, progression, and leaderboard records.

You might find a combination that works surprisingly well. Or spend an entire run trying to make something ridiculous work.

Both are part of the fun.

30+ RUNES THAT CHANGE HOW YOU PLAY

Before each run, choose up to three runes from more than 30 available to unlock.

Runes aren't just stat bonuses. They change how a run works, often giving you a powerful advantage in exchange for a serious drawback.

Rune of the Martyr

Start with five times your normal maximum health, but lose the ability to heal for the entire run. No regeneration, lifesteal, or other healing effects.

Pandemonium

Your damage varies between 1% and 500%, while incoming damage varies between 1% and 250%. Every hit becomes unpredictable, whether you're dealing damage or taking it.

Rune of Malice

Increase enemy spawn rate and the enemy cap by 150%, without gaining any direct stat bonuses. You'll have far more enemies to deal with, but also more opportunities to earn XP and gold.

Most runes are unlocked by mastering their associated magic types, while others require completing specific challenges and achievements.

Different rune combinations can completely change how you approach a run, even when playing the same mage.

OTHER PLAYERS' GRAVES

Sometimes you'll come across a grave left behind by another player.

Break it open and you can temporarily bring their fallen mage back to fight alongside you. Their health depends on the fallen player's run, and they'll only stay with you for a limited time.

It's a chance to get some extra help from another player's adventure, even if theirs didn't end particularly well.

WORLD EVENTS

Not every run follows the same pattern.

World events can interrupt your run and change what's happening on the battlefield.

Enemies might suddenly start exploding when killed. A Blood Stone might appear. A slime army could invade, or a Chronomancer might stop time and challenge you directly.

You can even encounter a champion based on one of your own previous runs, with additional health determined by how many enemies you killed during that run.

Some events give you new opportunities. Others make surviving much harder.

ENDLESS MODE AND LEADERBOARDS

Want to see how far your build can go?

Endless Mode lets you continue fighting against increasingly powerful enemies, pushing your build until you can no longer survive.

There are also special events you can only encounter in Endless Mode. I'll leave those for you to discover.

Your kill count is recorded on the global leaderboard, but there's also a separate leaderboard for every mage identity.

That means you can compete for the overall highest kill count or try to set a record with your favorite mage.

With hundreds of different mages, there's plenty of room to experiment with builds that other players might have overlooked.

ENDLESS TRIAL

Endless Trial is a separate wave-based mode with no final boss or exit. You survive for as many waves as you can.

Starting at wave 14, every third wave forces you to choose one of three handicaps. Your choice stays active for the rest of the run.

There are 18 different handicaps, and each can stack up to three levels.

As the waves progress, you'll have to deal with both stronger enemies and the disadvantages you've accumulated along the way.

Your highest wave is recorded on a separate global leaderboard.

DISCOVER, UNLOCK, AND GROW YOUR MAGES

Discovering a mage during a run is only the beginning.

Defeat a boss after transforming into that mage, and you'll unlock it permanently. You can then select it at level 1 when starting future runs, without having to recreate the same spell combination.

Every mage has its own progression and passives, giving you reasons to return to the ones you enjoy playing.

You'll also earn gold during runs to spend on permanent unlocks and upgrades.

There are challenges that change your starting conditions, runes to unlock, records to beat, and plenty of magic combinations left to discover.

Also included:

  • Permanent upgrades and unlocks

  • Challenges with different starting rules

  • Individual mage progression

  • 16 supported languages

Welcome to Woodland!

📖🌠 For centuries there was a legend circulating among the Forestians saying that if their world needed saving, there would appear a young hero, “The Wood”, and defeat the great danger. The time has come and not many are even able to move, yet protect the village and look for the source of their power - the Stone of Eternity. 

🌳👁️ Everyone in the village of Forrestians has gone asleep since their source of energy for the Fountain of Life has been stolen by the dark sorcerer, The Malachite. Everyone except a young and brave Wizzy, who nobody knows why, is awaken during the lack of the Stone of Eternity. But he has to hurry, because if the drought will last too long, his tribesmen will lose the rest of their energy.

🗝️🧭 To bring back the peace to his village, Wizzy will have to follow the right paths to get to the sorcerer, acquire new powers that will enable him fight off his enemies, and solve riddles which seem to be unsolvable. Unknown areas might be looking colorful and nice, but often want to get rid of the visitor as soon as possible, so the exploration has to proceed with caution.

🌟 So, will Wizzy be the one that people in Woodland have heard about for years to fulfill the legend?

Wizzy the Wood is a 3D platformer adventure game with a relaxed pace and a rich, magical world. Face off against mischievous creatures, powerful bosses, and overcome a variety of challenges that blend platforming, exploration, and logic-based puzzles. From mysterious forests to forgotten ruins, every corner of Woodland is packed with secrets, traps and magic.

Key Features:

🎮 Classic 3D platforming - Nostalgic gameplay inspired by legendary 3D adventure titles

🎨 Stylized and colorful world - Hand-crafted environments full of charm, character, and magical details

🧩 Puzzles & exploration - Solve environmental and logic-based puzzles while discovering hidden paths and lore

👹 Epic boss battles - Face off against unique enemies and magical creatures in story-driven encounters

📖 Lore-rich adventure - Dive into a light fantasy narrative with secrets and world-building elements to uncover

🧍‍♂️ Single-player experience - A focused third-person adventure with a relaxing pace and intuitive controls

👨‍👩‍👧 Family-friendly gameplay - Safe for all ages, perfect for casual play sessions and younger players

The journey starts when you decide to act!

Build Your Own Restaurant Empire

Start with a small restaurant and gradually grow it into a thriving food business. In Woks & Works, you will not only design your restaurant layout and create menus, but also manage employees, control inventory, plan supply chains, and respond to ever-changing customer demands.

Manage the Complete Production Chain, From Supply to Service

Every dish goes through a complete process:

  • Purchase fresh ingredients

  • Manage warehouse storage

  • Organize kitchen production

  • Assign tasks to employees

  • Serve customer orders

Plan your resources carefully and keep your restaurant running efficiently.

Every Customer Has Their Own Story

Customers come from different social classes, with unique incomes, spending habits, and dining preferences.

Students, workers, office employees, and wealthy customers will choose different dishes, shaping your business strategy. Understand your customers and build the restaurant that fits the market.

Manage Your Team

Chefs, servers, and other workers will act according to assigned tasks.

Organize your workforce, improve efficiency, and transform your restaurant from a chaotic small shop into a finely tuned business machine.

Design Your Restaurant Freely

Plan your kitchen, dining areas, warehouses, and workspaces.

Optimize your layout, reduce unnecessary movement, and create an efficient food production line of your own.

Adapt to a Changing Economy

Ingredient prices, market demand, and customer spending power will affect your business.

Adjust your menu, control costs, and find your path to success in a competitive restaurant industry.

Endless Possibilities

You can choose to:

  • Build a luxurious fine dining restaurant

  • Run an affordable neighborhood restaurant

  • Create an ultra-efficient automated kitchen

  • Build a massive restaurant empire

Your restaurant, your decisions.

Welcome to WONDERLAND GACHA HOUSE! The free trial is now live — download and give it a try!

Your humble home is an epic battlefield — desks, windowsills, bedrooms, kitchens... This miniature Wonderland is under siege by monsters. Become the will of the Gacha House, awaken adorable Figurine Heroes, and defend the peace of this tiny world!

Collect

  • Command 20 Figurine Heroes with wildly different mechanics, and experience all-new combat strategies and rhythms

  • Collect 100 adorable Figurines to fill up your display case

  • A true buy-once game — no in-app purchases, no duplicates, no fragments, no crafting — every box brings a fresh surprise

  • Mix and match 30+ weapons with 110+ pieces of support equipment to explore hundreds of build possibilities

Battle

  • Face surging monster hordes across miniature scenes like desks, windowsills, bedrooms, and kitchens

  • Turn everyday household items into tools that swing the tide of battle

  • Unleash each hero's one-of-a-kind Ultimate Skill to dominate the battlefield

  • Manage your Stamina and use Sprint to weave nimbly through dense bullet hells and monster hordes

  • Outsmart Bosses with clever tactics, or build an overpowered loadout to go head-on with them

Growth

  • Reshape your weapons to craft your own combat style

  • Explore 300 hero Talents and unlock a fully independent skill growth tree for every hero

  • Earn resource rewards from every battle and convert them into meta progression, making your heroes stronger with every fight

  • Turn on “The Chosen Mode” for automatic buffs, so even casual players can enjoy effortless, satisfying monster-mowing fun

GUESS THE HIDDEN WORDS

Every board hides twelve words. Pick one, type your guess, and watch it turn green. Solve all twelve before your lives run out.

NINE KINDS OF HINTS

Stuck? The hints come at every word from a different angle: a definition, a rhyme, a pair of emojis, a surprising fact, a word that means the same, an opposite hiding on the same board, the category it belongs to, and whether it is a noun or a verb.

Some hints tie two words together, like Word 4 loves to eat Word 9. Solve one and you are halfway to the other.

A wrong guess still pays off. It costs a life, but it reveals a letter and brings a fresh hint.

SCAN. JOIN. BATTLE.

Put Word Link on the TV and hand out the phones. Everyone scans the QR code, picks a team and types on their own phone. No app to install, no account to make.

Two to four teams share one board. A correct guess scores a point and keeps your turn going. A wrong one hands it over. First team to the target score wins.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

  • Single: one board, ten lives. Clear all twelve words.

  • Survival: endless boards. Lives and score carry over, and every correct guess earns a new hint. Your best run goes on the Steam leaderboard.

  • Versus: two to four teams on one screen, playing on phones or sharing one keyboard. Set the target score, the streak limit and an optional turn timer.

PLAY IN ENGLISH OR ARABIC

More than 3,000 words across dozens of categories, from animals and food to countries, feelings and describing words. Arabic is fully supported, right to left, with its own word lists and its own leaderboards.

Make the words. Max the score.

WordMaxed is a strategic, board-filling word game where every tile can transform the whole board. Build several words in one turn, chain combos, trigger multipliers, and decide whether to spend points now or save them for a bigger play.

Play Your Way

  • Solitaire — build at your own pace and chase a new personal best.

  • Player vs AI — choose Easy, Medium, or Hard and outscore the computer.

  • Pass & Play — take turns together on one device.

  • Online multiplayer — create a room for 2–4 friends, resume matches from My Games, and run it back with a rematch.

Quick Games or Big Plans

Choose a fast, combo-packed 5x5 board or settle into the larger 10x10 grid. Every game gives you new tactical problems to solve.

Place letters freely and create multiple words in one turn.

Stack multipliers, collect bonus potions, and chase long-word and max-out rewards.

Use special tiles such as The Stand-In, which can become the letter you need.

Swap tiles, shuffle your rack, recall placements, or ask Best Turn for help.

Daily Competition

Take on the Daily Challenge, where every player receives the same globally seeded board, then compare scores on the online leaderboards.

Learn through the interactive tutorial, save and resume unfinished games, and play with English, Spanish, or German text.

Track Your Progress

Explore achievements and check your progress toward word-building milestones in Settings.

The board looks like leftover letters. Then one piece drops, and a whole category of words lights up at once.
This is a spatial word puzzle. You drag shaped letter tiles onto a noisy grid, complete hidden answers, and use crossword-style intersections to crack the rest of the board.

See the pattern. Place the piece.

Each level starts with a category: Medieval, Space, Ocean, Food, Music, and more. Some letters are already locked in. Others are decoys, sitting there to hide the real words.
Your tray holds the missing parts: lines, L-shapes, squares, and other connected pieces. They move as one. Drop them on empty cells. When a word runs straight across or down, it resolves. When two words share a letter, one smart placement can finish both.
That click is the whole game: CROWN appearing, then KNIGHT through the same N.

Features

  • Shaped letter pieces you drag onto the grid, not type into it
  • Intersecting category words: one tile can solve more than one answer
  • Decoy letters that hide the pattern until you look closer
  • Themed puzzles where knowing the category actually helps
  • Pick up and rethink: pieces come back to the tray if you change your mind
  • Hints when you want a nudge, not a skip

Built for the quiet "oh, of course"

No timers. No pressure. Just you, a cluttered board, and the satisfaction of watching hidden words snap into place.
Fit the pieces. Find the words. Feel the click.

Wordy Space is a fast-paced space arcade game where typing is your weapon. Blast incoming threats, face bosses, and upgrade your ship. Chase high scores in Classic Mode, type to the beat in Beat the Beat, or turn each target into a translation challenge in Polyglot.

Fight with Words

Type the words on asteroids, satellites, aliens, and boss attacks to destroy them before they reach your ship. Keep your accuracy high, build combos, and withstand increasingly intense waves.

Choose and Upgrade Your Ship

Fly Orion, Scorpius, or Aquila, each with its own passive ability. Earn WS coins during runs and invest in permanent upgrades for your ship and powers.

Turn the Tide with Special Powers

Clear space with EMP, slow the action with Sands of Time, or strike multiple targets with Blackbolt. Choose the tools that suit your playstyle and use them when the pressure builds.

Beat the Beat: Type to the Rhythm

Time your words to the music, hit satellite notes with Shift, and hold through linked targets. Aim for precise timing and higher scores. Includes The Drifter's Illusion and an editor for creating your own song packages.

Polyglot: Translate to Survive

Type a target's translation instead of copying the word you see. Choose levels from A1 to C2 and combine several source languages with a single answer language. For example, a Turkish "elma" target is answered with "apple" in English. Practice in Learning Mode, revisit difficult words, and track your progress.

Create Your Own Content

Customize visual themes, prepare Polyglot word packs, and chart songs in the Beat the Beat editor. Use the Steam Workshop publishing tools to share themes, word packs, and song packages with the community.

Chase Your Next Record

Compete on global and dictionary-specific Steam leaderboards in Classic Mode. Your captain's log tracks runs, hunted words, typing speed, and accuracy, so you can follow your progress beyond a single score.

Nine Dictionary Languages

Play with German, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, and Turkish dictionaries.

Future Plans

Co-op and league-based PvP are planned for future updates, alongside continued dictionary and content improvements. These plans may change during development.

[Real-Time Strategy Control & Squad Tactics]

Combining RTS-style box-selection and control mechanics, players can unlock and command up to 5 characters with distinct abilities as the story progresses. Through precise micro-management and skill synergy in real-time combat, outmaneuver and overcome your foes.

[Deep Loot & Attribute Build Crafting]

Defeat powerful enemies to obtain materials and rare loot.

Learn skills through various means, hunt for materials to upgrade them, gaining attributes and Dao points along the way, enabling a secondary build for active skills.

[Interwoven Fates & Faction NPCs]

Rebirth:

According to the pact with the Natural Order, the newly reborn world would remain under a [Time Lock] until his return. Unfortunately, his archrival, the Slumber Mentor, had already detected the truth of the world's reset centuries before his awakening...

The protagonist, now awake, looks upon his fractured talents, his reset skills, and his bare equipment. This former Earthling wipes the sweat from his brow, forces a smile toward his archrival, and says:
"Can you at least not hit the face?"

Pact of That World (3/?)：

· Scales of Empire

· Cephalopod Wisdom

· Androgynous Dancer

     The sin of world-destruction—the original obsession of both the Transmigrator and the original body.

     Killing while fleeing—whence does the halo of virtue arise?

Powers Across the Realms (2/15):

     The Silver Moon Lady, who came from the Moon's Narrow Pass—why has she reappeared in this era?

· Beastmountain
     The Arthropod Lords, unheard of in the previous life—why have they now joined forces with the Spider Queen?

     Purged the evils of the outer realms, swept away the malevolence of the myriad hells. The sacred artifact <Justice> shattered the planar walls and ignited the Judgment War.
     All of it—for the sake of a certain "Transmigrator" destined to fall back through the cracks of time.

You are a Fürst. Starting with a single stretch of land, you must build a realm capable of surviving the Worldkampf. The clock never stops: your population grows, harvests come in, and rival lords make their moves whether you're watching or not.

A Living, Unforgiving Economy

Set your own tax rates and find the balance: push too hard, and your people will break away and declare themselves free. Trade resources with the Mysterious Guild or strike deals directly with rival Fürsten — the price drifts with supply and demand, and every deal you don't make, someone else will. Keep your subjects fed and content: happiness and morale shape everything from productivity to loyalty, so a thriving realm takes as much care as a growing one. Every Taler you collect, spend, or hoard is a choice — and your people are watching you make it.

The Burden of Empire

Bigger isn't always better. Push your realm past a certain size, and the administrative strain of holding it together starts eating into your morale and material output — a cost that lingers even once you stop expanding, so growth has to be managed, not just chased. Your armies need the same balance: neglect their upkeep, and regiments desert. Let the neglect go on long enough, and rebellion follows — town by town, your own subjects rising up to tear themselves free from your rule.

Steel Giants and Bitter Sieges

The age of static warfare is over. Command infantry, artillery, and the Kampfläufer — the towering walking machines that shattered the old world order. Lead your forces directly through your personal avatar, though if they fall in battle, so do the powerful boons they carry.

Feudal Diplomacy

Defeat isn't always death. Take a rival's palace and they kneel, becoming your vassal — keeping their throne while handing you a tithing. But vassals remember their humiliation, and once the enough time has passed, they'll start plotting rebellion.

Beyond the Sky

Beyond a single world is a galaxy.  Despite the war, the Guild's freighters keep running to off-world colonies, indifferent to the wars tearing the Empire apart. Fund an expedition, book passage, and land on a handcrafted world with nothing but what you shipped. Kneel a rival on one world, and they kneel on all of them.

Key Features

  • A World Built for War — Drop into a hand-crafted campaign set during the Empire's collapse, play an endless procedurally generated scenario, or take on one built by fellow players. No two maps, and no two wars, ever look the same.

  • The Grauer Markt — You may bid to hire out Gray Market factions: mercenary companies splintered from Wurzeltal's imperial armies, the counterculture Beatnicks hunting bloated war profiteers, the vengeful remnants of Nordheim, and more.

  • Many Paths to Victory — Seize and hold the capital of Kaiserstuhl, collect ten ancient relics and build a galaxy-spanning empire. Hold the threads from the back or wage war until the last enemy drops.

  • Create History — Use the full built-in editor and scripting engine to craft custom scenarios, place units by hand, and build your own campaigns.

Wretched Tales: Cinderella is a 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure that reimagines the classic fairy tale of Cinderella through the lens of a dark and twisted tale.

The player explores each scene through the eyes of Cinderella, left behind in an old house.
The goal on the surface is familiar: finish the chores, complete the preparations, and meet the conditions required to go to the ball.

But in this world, solving problems is never ordinary.

Objects slowly lose their original purpose, chores turn into strange procedures, and beauty is shaped by peculiar standards.
Players must click objects throughout each scene, use items, observe small changes, and uncover the rules behind each puzzle.

The puzzles in this game are not simply about entering codes or collecting items.
The position of an object, its altered appearance, repeated reactions, and wordless icons can all become clues.
You will obtain things, place them somewhere, use something else on them, and confirm the strange logic of each scene with your own hands.

Behind the fairy tale lies a dark world known as Querencia.
There, familiar objects and familiar goals work in unfamiliar ways.
Players must move between the fairy-tale world and Querencia, connecting clues, items, and changes in objects to solve puzzles.

Key Features

  • Point-and-click puzzles that ask you to read the rules of each scene

    • Investigate objects within static 2D scenes, and use small reactions and changes in state as clues to solve puzzles.

    • The answers are not hidden in written explanations.
      They are hidden in the position, shape, transformation, and repeated reactions of objects within the scene.

  • Object-based interactions that happen inside the scene

    • Obtain items and use them on specific objects in scenes or Zoom screens to progress.

    • Instead of combining items inside the inventory, you solve puzzles by placing items directly into the scene and connecting them with other items or objects.

  • Familiar fairy-tale goals, solved in grotesquely twisted ways

    • Familiar Cinderella goals appear throughout the game: chores, dressing up, invitations, and the ball.

    • But the process of reaching those goals is uncomfortable, strange, and sometimes darkly absurd.

  • Twisted Fairy Tales, Characters Rewritten

    • Under the influence of an unseen entity, the fairy tales we know are twisted into something strange and sinister.

    • Players solve puzzles by connecting clues hidden within altered objects and environments, uncovering the desires and secrets of characters long overshadowed by the protagonists.

  • An unpleasant yet absurd dark fairy-tale tone

    • This is a game where strange rules linger more than horror, broken order matters more than gore, and silence remains louder than screams.

    • Even as players solve each problem, they may begin to question whether the result they completed was ever truly right.

What You Will Do

Investigate old rooms.
Click small objects, remember strange reactions, and discover the hidden rules inside each scene.

Read the condition note, sort grains mixed into ash, repair incomplete things, and reshape the world into something that can be invited.

This is the story of Cinderella going to the ball.

No one said the path would be beautiful.

Recommended For

  • Players who enjoy solving puzzles by observing static 2D scenes

  • Players who prefer puzzle adventures built around object use, state changes, and moving between scenes

  • Players who enjoy interpreting visual clues and symbols rather than relying on text explanations

  • Players who like dark fairy tales, strange objects, and uncomfortable dark comedy

  • Players looking for a short but dense point-and-click adventure

Content Warning

This game may contain a dark fairy-tale atmosphere, unsettling imagery, grotesque body and object transformations, and depictions of a disturbing family relationship.

Place the beasts. Channel the elements. Break the throne.

Cards fall, elements chain, the multiplier catches fire.

Wuxing: Elemental Array Poker is a feng-shui roguelike deckbuilder. You don't just play a good poker hand — you place it onto a 3×3 altar, card by card, and let the Five Elements flow between cells. What you play matters. Where you put it matters just as much.

Fully playable in English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese.

Send each beast home

Fire lands in the South — the Vermilion Bird wakes.

Fill the storybook

Completing it is the long, quiet goal underneath everything else.

Overview

Stylish Infinite Loop! Sugoroku Drifter is a roguelike game where you build the sugoroku board itself as your deck, then aim to reach the target score set for each stage.

Build Your Run

The board isn't the only thing you can build and customize!

You can also collect different pieces that move around the board, as well as powerful Relics obtained by defeating bosses.

Discover powerful combinations and overcome increasingly demanding score targets!

▼ Examples of Board Spaces

  • Interest
    every time you pass it, you score based on how much money you have

  • Honey Bee
    scores more for every Plant tile on the board

▼ Examples of Pieces

  • Jumbo Jet
    Rolls 1d20. If luck is on your side, it can travel an absurd distance in a single move!

  • The Elder
    moves farther the further you advance through the stages

▼ Examples of Relics

  • Strawberry
    Forces every roll of 1 to become a 5.

  • DORA
    each stage, a random tile becomes DORA — stop on it for 3x the score

Bosses Appear Every Few Stages

Alongside regular stages, where your only goal is to reach the target score, there are also Boss Stages.

Bosses inflict all kinds of nasty debuffs that interfere with your run.

Fortunately, you can check each boss's debuffs before starting the stage, so prepare your build in advance and don't let the boss ruin your perfect board!

▼ Examples of Boss Abilities

  • Forces Forced Stop tiles into your board.

  • Any space you land on once will never activate again for the rest of the stage.

Tons of Playable Characters with Unique Abilities

As you play, you'll gradually unlock a variety of characters, each with their own unique abilities.

Make the most of their strange and powerful traits and aim for even higher scores!

▼ Examples of Character Abilities

  • Great Cosmic Collective Will Senpai
    Starts the game with powerful 2d6 dice.

  • Dark Glasses Maid Elf Senpai
    sees her next roll, and her Ult swaps it with the current one

  • Supergalactic Governor Senpai
    pay money to fire her Ult anytime

★ Win or Lose, You Get a Random Haiku!

It has absolutely no effect on the gameplay whatsoever, but whether you win or lose, a random haiku will always be recited on the results screen!

Isn't that nice?!
